## Data Cleaning

library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)

heart_data <- read.csv("heart.csv")

head(heart_data)
dim(heart_data)

write.csv(heart_data, "heart_original.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

original_rows <- nrow(heart_data)

heart_data <- unique(heart_data)

cleaned_rows <- nrow(heart_data)

original_rows
cleaned_rows

original_rows - cleaned_rows
